description: The file defines the interface for a block source abstraction used in reftable, including function declarations for reading, closing, and releasing block data, as well as creating an in-memory block source.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes the block source and underlying resource; a no-op if source is zero-initialized.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads a block of data from the source at a specified offset and length into a destination.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the total length of the underlying resource.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a block data object and returns it to its source.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Creates an in-memory block source for reading reftables from a buffer.
